title: [BUG] 5 hour limit reached after only 3 hours
body: ## Environment - Platform (select one): - [ ] Anthropic API - [ ] AWS Bedrock - [ ] Google Vertex AI - [X ] Other: Claude Code 4 Sonnet - Claude CLI version: - Operating System: MacOS 14.7.1 - Terminal: Claude Code v1.0.89 L Session ID: 5966a933-6df3-4017-9468-bbf5f50bdf52 Working Directory L /Users/iwolf/Repos/beascout IDE Integration • /config ✔ Connected to Visual Studio Code extension L Installed VS Code extension version 1.0.89 (server version: 1.0.57) Account • /login L Login Method: Claude Pro Account L Organization: irawolf81@gmail.com's Organization L Email: irawolf81@gmail.com Model • /model L Sonnet Sonnet 4 for daily use ## Bug Description At 10pm 22Aug2025 EST, I was notified that my limit was reached and that it would reset at 12am (midnight). I resumed my Claude Code session at midnight, accidentally closed my VS Code instance, reopened it and started a new Claude Code session. At 3am 23Aug2025, I was notified with "5-hour limit reached ∙ resets 5am". I was active for only 3 hours, yet my 5 hour limit was reached. ## Steps to Reproduce See Bug Description ## Expected Behavior I expected to be notified my 5 hour limit was reached at 5am after resuming session at midnight. ## Actual Behavior My 5 hour session was terminated 2 hours early. ## Additional Context Did the 5 hour time incorrectly start when my prior session was halted instead of when it was resumed?

top_comments.body: What it means is the token limit has been reached, and you have to wait for the next 5-hour cycle, when it will reset. It doesn't mean you can use it for 5 hours or something like that, but that for every 5 hours you have a certain amount of tokens to spend. Besides the 5-hour window, there's also a weekly window recently introduced, but I don't know much about that yet. Here's more info:
